headlines.title: Justice Department threatens legal action against California over alleged noncitizen voters
headlines.description: The DOJ demanded election officials review a list of possible noncitizens within 48 hours and “segregate” any mail ballots they sent in.

headlines.title: Feds seized Rep. Ilhan Omar’s phone, subpoenaed family members in immigration status probe
Vatican says Pope Leo's lung surgery recovery is 'proceeding as expected'
headlines.description: Pope Leo XIV underwent thoracic surgery after being diagnosed with adenocarcinoma, a type of non-small cell lung cancer. NBC News' Claudio Lavanga shares the latest updates from the Vatican, while Dr. Natalie Azar breaks down the diagnosis and recovery outlook.

headlines.title: Ukraine accuses SpaceX of restricting Starlink, disrupting military amid Trump pressure
headlines.description: Ukrainian officials and military units accused Elon Musk’s SpaceX of throttling a technology at the heart of their battlefield communications and drone operations.

headlines.title: Investigation Underway Into France Supermarket Cyberattack
headlines.description: An investigation is underway into an unprecedented cyberattack on hundreds of French supermarkets that is still spreading across the country. Hackers are taking over refrigeration systems, overriding temperature settings and pushing some refrigeration units above 120 degrees while stores were closed. Now, many are worried about how vulnerable these systems could be in any country. NBC's Tom Costello reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Social Security recipients will receive a 3.6% cost-of-living increase in 2027
headlines.description: Individual retirement benefits will climb an average of about $75 per month, according to an advocacy group.

headlines.title: Romance scammers are getting harder to catch. The consequences are costly.
headlines.description: For people looking for love online, a match with a scammer could cost them their life savings.

headlines.title: Trump pardons two vehicle repair shop owners during Alaska rally
headlines.description: During his rally in Alaska, President Trump pardoned Zachary Czuback and Patrick Fleming, co-owners of a vehicle repair shop in Anchorage. Both pleaded guilty in 2022 to violating the Clean Air Act by tampering with federally mandated and monitored devices that tracked vehicles’ diesel emissions.

headlines.title: Watchdog group sues Trump administration over Jared Kushner’s government work
headlines.description: A watchdog group filed suit Wednesday alleging President Donald Trump’s son-in-law Jared Kushner’s current role as a top envoy for the administration is unlawful and raises numerous conflict-of-interest concerns.

headlines.description: Welcome to From the Politics Desk, a daily newsletter that brings you the NBC News Politics team’s latest reporting and analysis from the White House, Capitol Hill and the campaign trail.

headlines.description: With less than three weeks before Election Day, Steve Kornacki is ready to answer your questions on all things midterms.

headlines.description: Celine Dion is being made into a Barbie doll, one that will be sought by fans near, far, wherever they are.
